# List of national monuments of Pakistan

According to Pakistan Environmental Protection Agency, as of October 1997, there are 10 National Monuments within the country. An additional monument, Pakistan Monument was built in the capital, Islamabad, during the 2000s. There are four monuments in Sindh (all in Karachi), five in Punjab (out of which four are in Lahore), and one in Balochistan.
